headings.text:
CONNECT INWARD
ORACLE CARD EXPERIANCE

Step into a grounding, intuitive space where you'll receive guidance and learn to read your own cards with clarity and confidence.


​

Oracle Experience. Group Session

A guided experience where you'll connect inward, to recieve guidance and learn to read your own cards in a relaxed, supportive space.

-60 minutes
-Limited to 12 guests
*450k per person

Private Oracle Experience

A personalised one-on-one session designed to deepen your connection, offering intuitive guidance while teaching you to trust  and read your own cards.

-60 minutes
-Private setting
*750k

OMG Blessing Ritual

A private, immersive ritual to connect, activate and bless your oracle deck.
This experience weaves together gentle, sound, intention, and ceremony - allowing you to form a deeper, more intuitive relationship with your cards.
Each ritual is uniquely guided, creating a moment of clarity, connection and self-trust.

-90 minutes
-Includes your OMG Oracle Deck to take home
*1.1 million


Our most immersive and loved experience

* Not sure which experience is
for you ?
Send us a message - were happy to guide you.

desktop-1440.title: Holiday Yoga & Sound Day Retreat | The Yoga Shala Lembo

meta.description: Unwind and rejuvenate with our special Holiday Yoga & Sound Day Retreat at The Yoga Shala Lembo. This full day of yoga and feel-good experiences includes a morning Vinyasa session, followed by a unique Hammock Soundscape relaxation experience. After a relaxing break at a nearby café, join us for a gentle pre-sunset Yin yoga class. The day concludes with your choice of a Gong relaxation or Sound Journey session. It's the perfect way to treat yourself to a day of tranquility and wellness.

The creator of Omg Oracle cards will be your guide for this experience, you can even purchase your very own OMG - Oh My Goddess Clarity Oracle card deck to take home.

desktop-1440.title: Restore & Pamper Day Retreat. | The Yoga Shala Lembo

meta.description: Indulge in an afternoon of pure relaxation with our Restore & Pamper Retreat at Island Yoga. Join us for a gentle 60-minute Yin Yoga session - perfect if your a beginner, followed by 2 hours of complete bliss with our Goddess treatment, including a relaxation massage, body scrub, and flower bath soak. All topped off with tea and fresh fruit, this divine experience will leave you feeling completely restored.
